examples.note: Same canonical selections as the first summary example; order, duplicates, label case and status display aliases preserve cursor binding.
Unwatched rows still state watched:false, without unread/activity counters; workflow Done and closed state retain separate timestamps.

Exact membership provenance survives truncated display relations. order_anchor_ms is authoritative query comparator data: integer including created-at fallback, explicit null when unknown (sorts last); present only for order:anchor.

project_identities.note: Optional coordinator or worker purpose is captured independently of name before a project agent leaves its roster. Older records may omit it; clients must not infer coordinator from a project-prefixed id alone.

activity_sessions.note: Watched tasks carry the current activity streak from meaningful timeline entries and a durable checkpoint for silent content edits, split at a gap of 8h or more; read marks and attention bookkeeping do not extend it. tasks.list, tasks.get and board.list use the same summary.

summaries.selection_semantics: OR within a dimension; AND across dimensions. Scalar and plural forms together are invalid, even for null or empty values.
summaries.cursor_binding: Store, project, summary mode and canonical selections; equivalent case/order/duplicate selections reuse a cursor.
summaries.sparse_pages: An empty tasks array with next_cursor is valid; continue until next_cursor is absent.
summaries.truncation: Display-only title, workspace navigation and tracker lists may be capped with summary_truncated:true. Invalid stored labels or oversized opaque IDs are explicit errors; tasks are never silently omitted or retried at the same cursor.

reply.error: task summary exceeds 65536 bytes; repair the stored row before continuing

refusals.note: Oversized stored data is an explicit unavailable error. The refusal has no result or continuation and cannot silently omit a task.

reply.error: attention_rule must be asked or legacy

selectors.done_since: inclusive epoch milliseconds; done status only
selectors.exclude_assignee: exact agent/user/project_agent assignee object; no extra fields

ordering.anchor: anchor ASC, number DESC; missing anchor sorts last

exact_queries.basis: opaque persisted project projection generation shared by list/counts/lookup reads only; mutation replies do not return it
exact_queries.cursor: bound to store/project/all normalized selectors/order/projection generation; no snapshots across writes
exact_queries.matched_memberships: Per-row exact linked_workspace_id/tracker_agent_id match provenance, independent of truncated display links/trackers.
exact_queries.search: No substring/locale search capability is advertised.
exact_queries.immediate_effects: Client local mutation epoch plus post-ack authoritative refresh; no arithmetic count overlays.

agent_surface_streams.note: Each stream has its own explicit continuation. These example project active statuses are backlog/in_progress; consumers derive the complete non-review/non-Done selection from configured project columns, never from loaded task rows. Working/Assigned are retargeted together from cached working observation. Closed wins over all open groups. Assignment wins over tracking across every state/status.
agent_surface_streams.history: Tracked has no state/status filter and excludes assigned agent exactly, including finished rows; Done and Closed remain independent streams.

exact_queries.review_summary_mode: Summary rows preserve additive review_summary.mode; canonical legacy review summaries are unchanged. Missing canonical stored review mode is snapshot for exclusion.
exact_queries.order_anchor_ms: Only order:anchor rows: integer actual comparator anchor (including source fallback), explicit null for unknown sentinel sorting last. Other orders omit this field.

basis_fencing.comparison: Opaque persisted store-incarnation/projection-generation basis. Compare equality only within the same store; foreign-store tokens are incomparable. Never parse, lexically order, increment, subtract or perform arithmetic on a basis.
basis_fencing.mutation_reply: No query basis is returned by mutation acknowledgment.

scenarios.name: late aggregate before acknowledgment
steps: Issue aggregate read at local mutation epoch N, capturing basis B.
Start user read/watch/assignment mutation; increment local epoch to N+1.
Old aggregate read arrives before acknowledgment.
Reject old aggregate installation because its captured local epoch N is obsolete.

scenarios.name: late aggregate after acknowledgment
steps: Issue aggregate read at epoch N.
Start user mutation; increment local epoch to N+1.
Mutation acknowledgment arrives without query basis.
Old aggregate arrives after acknowledgment; reject because epoch N is obsolete.
Issue fresh aggregate read after acknowledgment at epoch N+1.
Install fresh totals directly; no arithmetic overlay or double count.

scenarios.name: second mutation while refreshed read is pending
steps: After acknowledgment, issue fresh aggregate read at epoch N+1.
Another user mutation begins; increment epoch to N+2.
Read issued at N+1 arrives; reject despite being newer than the original read.
After second acknowledgment, refresh again and install authoritative totals directly.

ordered_timestamp_domain.name: ecmascript-iso-v1
ordered_timestamp_domain.accepted: Complete Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD or signed six-digit expanded year except -000000; date-only UTC. Full uppercase T HH:mm:ss with optional 1..9 fractional digits and mandatory Z or ±HH:mm. Hours 00–23, seconds 00–59, offset hours 00–23/minutes 00–59. Fraction truncated to first three digits, padded right; UTC TimeClip inclusive ±8.64e15 applied after offset.
ordered_timestamp_domain.rejected: Negative-zero year, invalid Gregorian date, lowercase, leap seconds, 24 hour, zone-less datetime, informal dates, fractions outside 1..9 digits, TimeClip overflow. Nonstring values refuse.
ordered_timestamp_domain.validity_scope: Conservative project/order validity evaluated before candidate reads in the same transaction/basis. A malformed timestamp in an excluded task or outside the window refuses the affected order/cutoff. Number/priority without done_since and counts/lookup remain available.
ordered_timestamp_domain.client_refusal: Preserve cached rows/cursor; no automatic retry until corrected data.
ordered_timestamp_domain.unknown: Absent/null/empty timestamps map to Unknown rather than Unsupported. Other nonempty invalid/outside-domain values map to Unsupported.
ordered_timestamp_domain.fraction_note: 1..9 digits are the deterministic native-producer extension beyond normative ECMA three-digit milliseconds.
ordered_timestamp_domain.validation: 31 known shared fixtures match Node 22.23.4/26.12.1 and Chromium 152.0.7977.82; 13 browser-accepted strings intentionally refused. See docs/task-query-timestamp-domain.md.

canonical_marker_domain.name: opaque-marker-v1
canonical_marker_domain.measurement: UTF-8 bytes of raw canonical read/watch-start/dismiss marker, not Unicode scalar count or display projection length. Embedded NUL is supported and counted as one UTF-8 byte.
canonical_marker_domain.canonical_writes: Canonical write acceptance and legacy behavior are preserved. This is an explicit bounded-read domain, not a write validation restriction.
canonical_marker_domain.validity_scope: Materialized conservative whole-project marker invalidity, read in the same transaction/basis before any dependent success, including markers on excluded/off-page tasks. No request-time catalogue drain.
affected_operations: tasks.list with attention_rule asked or legacy
canonical_marker_domain.independent_operations: Number/updated/priority/anchor list ordering without attention_rule retains existing validation; tasks.lookup retains existing validation. Counts fails as a whole because watched_unread_total is part of every response.
canonical_marker_domain.capabilities: Existing tasks.counts and tasks.listAttention at wire 3.27.0 include this explicit domain; no additional capability.

examples.name: canonical absence
examples.meaning: None; preserve absence and canonical fallback where defined

examples.name: present empty marker
examples.meaning: Some(empty); preserve present empty floor and bypass watch-start None fallback

fences.name: same basis
steps: Import or canonical write stores an overlong marker.
Commit marker invalidity and its projection generation atomically.
Dependent count/attention read in that basis refuses before success, even if the task is excluded or outside its candidate window.

fences.name: rollback
steps: Attempt marker change and projected count/attention invalidity update.
Roll back canonical mutation, projection facts and generation together.
A read of the previous basis keeps its previous supported/refused outcome.

fences.name: repair
steps: Correct or remove the overlong canonical marker through a supported producer or explicit repair.
Atomically clear project invalidity and advance projection generation.
Explicit fresh dependent read can return authoritative counts/attention again; an old continuation obeys ordinary basis restart rules.

canonical_marker_domain.client_refusal: Preserve cached rows, totals and cursor. No result or cursor accompanies refusal. Do not interpret as empty/exhausted, automatically retry, or drain pages; retry explicitly after data correction.
canonical_marker_domain.stored_fields_only: These markers are stored canonical fields, not new request selector parameters.
canonical_marker_domain.absence_and_empty: Missing/None/JSON null preserve canonical absence. Empty string is supported at zero bytes and remains a PRESENT empty floor; no trimming, case-folding, NUL removal or whitespace normalization.
canonical_marker_domain.watch_start_fallback: Absent/null watch_started_after uses latest watched-fact fallback; present empty watch_started_after bypasses fallback and compares as an empty floor.
canonical_marker_domain.read_and_dismiss: Canonical read/dismiss None remains absent; Some(empty string) remains present empty, following canonical comparison behavior.
